independent_cluster_boundary: recording block represented by an explicit cluster_id; frames/windows are not independent replicates
held_out_requirements: held-out recording days are disjoint from development recording days
held-out focal scenes/flowers are disjoint from development focal scenes/flowers
one cluster belongs to exactly one split
both development and held-out contain at least one cluster
forbidden: random frame-level split within a recording cluster
same recording day in development and held-out
same focal scene/flower in development and held-out
select double-annotation windows after model outputs are visible
use held-out data for calibration or threshold choice
freeze_requirement_remaining: Populate, validate, commit and SHA-register the realised dataset manifest after the sampling plan and actual field inventory exist; no placeholder allocation counts as frozen.
claim_boundary: Validator implementation only; no realised split, sample size, field performance or held-out result.
